title: Establishment of the Great Ci'en Monastery
shortSummary: The monastery created a new institutional setting for Buddhism, translation and imperial patronage in Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: Foundation is separated from later translation bureaux, pagoda phases and biographies so a long institutional history is not compressed into one date.
researchNote: Foundation account, precinct, early offices and project relationships require further verification.
